source: ZapSafe bundled reference · Day 311 EU pack · 112 is EU-wide mandated (Council Decision 91/396/EEC, Directive 2002/22/EC) · verify locally before travel

countries.notes: 112 works free of charge from any phone (with or without SIM/credit) in all 27 EU member states. This is the universal baseline — use it if unsure which country-specific number applies.
